_what: The two choices the message box sends with (src/workspace/send-choices.ts), read from the person's own share list (src/share-destinations.mjs): where it goes (their own Trillion and each pursuit, nested as the sidebar shows them, several at once, with a new pursuit made from typed words, `new_now` being where it stands when made) and what their AI does with it (one of their saved actions). Each shows only when there is something to choose. `private_icon` marks their own Trillion, `pursuit_icon` a pursuit only they are in, `with_people_icon` one with other people in it and `tool_icon` a tool that takes what is shared; `action_icon` marks a saved action and `folder_icon` a folder of them, which opens as its own menu. `sent` says where it went, with {places}. `route` is the default: with nothing chosen the box names no place and Trillion routes the share itself; `choose_where` / `hide_where` open and close the pickers, `waiting` is the quiet line while a kept share waits for the account. What is said after a send is in send-routed.json.
